name: house-scout
description: Research and compare specific homes: local listing searches, layout fit, declared costs, dated transit evidence and named amenities. Keep missing evidence explicit; no booking or payment. Requires host-authorized research tools and Python for bundled helpers.
default_prompt: Compare these homes: check layouts, costs, commutes and nearby amenities. Cite sources and flag unknowns.
benchmark_disclosure: 4/24 current-priced dated commute plans complete; not globally verified available housing.
